faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for HLL Lifecare recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Graduate / Degree Apprentice and Diploma / Technician Apprentice posts is 11th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in HLL Lifecare recruitment?
faq.answer: HLL Lifecare has announced a total of 30 vacancies for Graduate / Degree Apprentice and Diploma / Technician Apprentice positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Graduate / Degree Apprentice?
faq.answer: For the Graduate / Degree Apprentice role, candidates must possess a BE, B.Tech, BA, BSc, BBA, B.Com, or BCA degree in any stream.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for Diploma / Technician Apprentice?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Diploma / Technician Apprentice position must have a Diploma in any stream.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Graduate / Degree Apprentice?
faq.answer: The selected Graduate / Degree Apprentice will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 12,300/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Diploma / Technician Apprentice?
faq.answer: The selected Diploma / Technician Apprentice will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 10,900/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application for this recruitment must be submitted via Email.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for HLL Lifecare apprenticeships?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Selection Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for HLL Lifecare recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. Where is HLL Lifecare located?
faq.answer: HLL Lifecare is located in Trivandrum, Kerala, with the pincode 695005.
